protocol.inversion: Linear inverse clipped to old P10-P90 input support. GP minimizes squared posterior-mean mismatch over 2001 equally spaced supported inputs; no extrapolation.
protocol.gp_noise: Sample variance of three seed-specific conditional means divided by 3; GP posterior std concerns the mean response, not molecular spread.
protocol.selection: Same candidates, top4 vs Gaussian sampling without replacement sigma=.25 or .5 eV, plus uniform control; 100 deterministic selection repetitions. No training or coordinate optimization.
